title: ActionMeta
description: What the phone may know about an action (SRD 7.6). The run block -- argv, cwd, env, shell -- is NEVER sent. Unknown fields are ignored (PROTO-002).

icon.description: Icon name from the shared icon set.

description.description: Optional longer description; may be empty.

interactive.description: Whether the run accepts stdin and resize.

confirm.description: Whether the phone must confirm before running.

parallel.description: Whether more than one run of this action may be active.

has_status.description: Whether the action has a status probe.
